mutant.expected: MUTANT-OLD-TRUNCATES: pre-fix PATH_RE must still produce 4/4 false GONEs on the fixtures (else the corpus never exercised the defect); method mutants: a duplicated corpus file must surface as duplicated rows, and an unpaginated call behind a paginated sibling must be caught by the line-local re-check.
mutant.observed: Battery: pre-fix pattern failed 4/4 as expected. M1: dup rows surfaced (comp-deadgrant listed twice), dedupe applied, denominators re-derived 244->237/431->398. M2: line-local re-check flagged 19/38 file-scoped auto-safe rows; rule replaced, 8 rows reclassified Tier-2 confirmed.

declared_exclusions.item: Transitive imports of engine modules (an engine's own imports outside org/modules/graph)
declared_exclusions.reason: Corpus bound = wrappers + engine home + directly wrapper-invoked .py. One hop keeps the denominator derivable and honest; a transitive-closure corpus is unbounded without a module graph pass. Named here so the boundary is visible, not silent.
The TO's own DO-NOT: classify only; each fix rides its own tool's row with its own reviewer.
